scope: New separate stdlib-only helper authenticates every input_sha256 and all original source-manifest files twice, using externally pinned completion/source-manifest/original Docker execution receipt. No array interpretation, numerical inference, provider, broker, sender, replay, producer, publication or CLI wiring.

admission.external_pins: Frozen Pins requires exact SHA256 for all three receipts plus an explicit original-full-27471/2431 or distinct complete-private-v10/2428 profile. The full profile has NOT been exercised against the active original output.
admission.revision_limit: The external manifest pin and actual file hashes authenticate bytes. declared_source_revision is explicit provenance; source_revision_authenticated_by_git remains false. No Git object or absent full-run execution receipt is invented.
admission.metadata: Strict bounded reads before allocation, duplicate-member/nonfinite/exponent-overflow rejection, immutable external pins, regular files and stable descriptor/path identities.
admission.inputs: Every declared input and source is mandatory, including unused legacy arrays. Missing files, null/MISSING sentinels, corrupt bytes, writable/unmapped mounts, noncanonical paths and symlink escapes fail. No allow-missing or alias-substitution flag exists.
admission.streaming: 1MiB digest chunks; full before/after passes compare exact file and namespace-symlink identities. No np.load or financial/model imports.
admission.symlink_diagnosis: An initial HOST-only metadata/stat check reported146 SIP aliases missing. Exact original namespace inspection corrected this: frozen market/bars_15m_sip is the original symlink -> /original/bars_15m_sip, and the pinned Docker receipt supplies that read-only mount. The helper reconstructs readlink/lstat chains within that receipt namespace, rejects cycles/unknown/writable escapes and host-root symlinks, and binds final bytes to original completion hashes. No original receipt or file was rewritten.
